objective: Independent cross-year confirmation comparing e1p3 and e1p4 over all 75 official 2025 teams and all 11 2024 final2 teams, under the current four-zombie 2025 arena.

design.balancing: All teams occur at least once per panel; one distinct team is repeated per panel to complete 29 full three-team cohorts, rotating the repeat across panel order.
design.pairing: Fresh panel partition and seed are shared by both candidates.
design.primaryMetric: Candidate team score per battle averaged over the complete 86-team cross-year field.
